description: This Java class implements the service logic for re-aging and undo re-aging of loans within the Apache Fineract project. It handles creating re-aging transactions, validation, schedule regeneration, and event notifications.

classes.name: LoanReAgingServiceImpl
classes.description: Service class providing re-aging and undo re-aging logic for loans, including transaction creation, validation, schedule regeneration, and event notification.

methods.name: reAge
methods.description: Performs re-aging of a loan, creating a re-age transaction, processing schedule updates, and notifying events.

methods.name: undoReAge
methods.description: Reverses a re-aging transaction, regenerates schedules if necessary, and notifies events.

methods.name: reverseReAgeTransaction
methods.description: Reverses a re-aging transaction with proper validation.

methods.name: findLatestNonReversedReAgeTransaction
methods.description: Finds the most recent non-reversed re-age transaction for the given loan.

methods.name: createReAgeTransaction
methods.description: Creates a new re-age transaction for the loan based on the command input.

methods.name: createReAgeParameter
methods.description: Creates and initializes the re-age parameters from the command data.

methods.name: persistNote
methods.description: Persists an optional note attached to the loan.
